hotels.description: Breathe in the fresh air of New South Wales’ wine country at this glamping and resort stay at Parklands Resort. An elevated experience and prime location sets these immaculate digs apart in Mudgee and beyond, setting the scene for comfort and relaxation at the gateway to a marvellous food and wine region. Surrounded by 30 acres of meticulously landscaped gardens, the resort is the ultimate base from which to explore the countryside, discover various vineyards and sit back to soak in the serenity. Sample delectable local wine varietals at Vine Restaurant & Bar, adventure through expansive nature reserves or take a relaxing dip in the resort’s indoor pool and bubbling spa. To get the heart rate up, stop by the tennis court or the well-equipped gym, and cap off your evenings with a stroll through the resort's breathtaking grounds.
